meaning:
1) line, measuring-line
2) (BDB) onomatapoetic mimicry of Isaiah's words, perhaps senseless

elsewhere.note: He made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it…
Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.
Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.
